newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cyclicals lead as Helsinki recovers with Europe.
newsitem.headline: Cyclicals lead as Helsinki recovers with Europe.

text.p: Finnish shares recovered on Wednesday as international sentiment was cheered by U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comments on Tuesday while appreciation pressure on the markka eased, brokers said.

The HEX index closed up 1.22 percent at 2,724.76 in volume a fair 560 million, 38 percent of it in Nokia which added 1.50 markka to 315.00. But Nokia traded most day below its New York close which corresponded to 316.50 markka.

Cargo handling equipment maker Partek surprised the market with news of a planned merger with state heavy vehicle maker Sisu, but failed to hold gains after an initial eight percent leap. Partek closed 1.00 markka lower at 75.00.
Instead, cyclical metal and forestry shares took the lead: the metals sub-index rose 1.6 percent.
The forest industry sub-index added 1.57 percent after Enso said its profit in September-December 1996 exceeded the profit in May-August. Though it gave no details, it helped the sector.

Rautaruukki rose on its CEO's comments that steel prices could rise this year, and trading was boosted by an announcement late on Tuesday that the government had appointed advisers on a potential further float of the company.
It closed almost three percent up at 45.30 markka.
